summary: The county jail booked nine people on criminal charges dated Saturday, Nov. 14, and two more early Sunday, among them a domestic strangulation arrest, a Foley felon-with-a-firearm arrest and a family-harassment arrest. No new court releases, agency statements or news reports on Baldwin crime were found overnight.

entries.title: Domestic strangulation arrest: William Edward Fields Jr.
body: William Edward Fields Jr., 53, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 1:02 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

He was booked on a charge of domestic violence by strangulation — strangling or suffocating a family or household member — and on a felony failure-to-appear charge. He was in custody when the roster was read early Sunday.

entries.title: Felon-with-a-firearm arrest, Foley: Jared Byron Morrow
body: Jared Byron Morrow, 39, was arrested by Foley police at 4:44 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13, and booked into the county jail Nov. 14, according to the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a charge of possessing a firearm as a convicted felon — having a gun after a felony conviction. He was in custody when the roster was read early Sunday.

entries.title: Family harassment arrest: Cynthia Attaway
body: Cynthia Attaway, 64, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 3:37 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
She was booked on a charge of harassing a family member — harassment directed at a family or household member. She was in custody when the roster was read early Sunday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 13–14: Brian Matthew Byus, Meghan Lee Bagwell, Pierson Reese Atkinson, Ebony Shamir Hood, Bryan Eugene Robinson
body: The sheriff's office arrested Brian Matthew Byus, 42, at 6:10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol; he was booked Nov. 14. On Saturday the sheriff's office arrested Meghan Lee Bagwell, 41, at 1:10 p.m. on a third-degree retail theft charge and Pierson Reese Atkinson, 29, at 7:24 a.m. on a charge of possessing dangerous drugs, and Bay Minette police arrested Ebony Shamir Hood, 34, at 9:22 a.m. on a third-degree criminal trespass charge — entering or staying on property unlawfully. The roster shows all four released Nov. 14.

The sheriff's office also arrested Bryan Eugene Robinson, 31, at 7:01 a.m. Saturday on felony and misdemeanor failure-to-appear charges; he was in custody when the roster was read early Sunday. All information is from the jail roster.
